title: Ready for School | Manipuri Kids Song, Nursery Rhymes, Children's Rhymes | BuBu TV - Manipuri
description:
A cheerful Manipuri rhyme about getting ready for school: wash up, put on your uniform, pack your bag and wave bye-bye to Amma.
It teaches children to check their school bag every day, and a surprise squirrel shows why!

Treng treng! Leiwendi, leiwendi!
Lei lei leiwemma, suridu chadu
Mukam kadukundam, chalhe chalhe ga
Shu ktu, ktu, ktu, nanana
Yunifaram waikukhannam, reddy!
Bagu waipu midaha, dhab dhab dhab
Tiffin box chaitilo
Pad pad pad pad
Badiki manam oladam!
Anna bagu tarichadu, ayo!
Adutha dukindi, "hi!"
Lagu lagu lagu, biscuit mukha!
"Agu agu!" antu arichāru
Bagu waipu midaha, dhab dhab dhab
Tiffin box chaitilo
Pad pad pad pad
Badiki manam oladam!
Amma nawindi, "o my, o my!"
Ingo biscuit pettindi
Ginzaha ginzaha ginzaha ginzaha, udathaki!
Rozu bagu tsusukondi!
Bagu waipu midaha, dhab dhab dhab
Tiffin box chaitilo
Pad pad pad pad
Badiki manam oladam!
Tata tata, bye bye Amma
Nadudam nadudam waikuku
Pat pat pat pat, school van wallindi
Saintram kludam!
